description: Frozen Ed25519 root signatures over ZWA1ROOT canonical payload, verifiable independently in Rust (ed25519-dalek) and JS (tweetnacl). Generated from deterministic seeds [1;32] and [2;32] per RFC8032.
canonical_encoding: ZWA1ROOT 8B | kind 1B (1=issuer,2=credential) | version 8B BE | valid_from 8B BE | expires_at 8B BE | id_len 1B | id | root 32B BE (BN254 scalar)
notes: Signs exactly canonical_bytes() from zwa-credentials::envelope — no reserialization
Golden vectors must remain stable — changing payload layout breaks compatibility

verification.js: const nacl=require('tweetnacl'); const ok=nacl.sign.detached.verify(Buffer.from(canonical_hex,'hex'), Buffer.from(sig_hex,'hex'), Buffer.from(pubkey_hex,'hex')); // true
const nacl=require('tweetnacl'); const ok=nacl.sign.detached.verify(Buffer.from(canonical_hex,'hex'), Buffer.from(sig_hex,'hex'), Buffer.from(pubkey_hex,'hex')); // true

js_verification_example: const nacl=require('tweetnacl'); function verify(hexPayload, hexSig, hexPub){return nacl.sign.detached.verify(Buffer.from(hexPayload,'hex'), Buffer.from(hexSig,'hex'), Buffer.from(hexPub,'hex'));} console.log(verify(issuer.canonical_payload_hex, issuer.ed25519_signature_hex, issuer.ed25519_pubkey_hex)); console.log(verify(credential.canonical_payload_hex, credential.ed25519_signature_hex, credential.ed25519_pubkey_hex));
rust_verification_example: use ed25519_dalek::{VerifyingKey, Signature, Verifier}; fn verify(payload_hex:&str, sig_hex:&str, pubkey_hex:&str)->bool{ let payload=hex::decode(payload_hex).unwrap(); let sig_bytes: [u8;64]=hex::decode(sig_hex).unwrap().try_into().unwrap(); let pub_bytes: [u8;32]=hex::decode(pubkey_hex).unwrap().try_into().unwrap(); let vk=VerifyingKey::from_bytes(&pub_bytes).unwrap(); let sig=Signature::from_bytes(&sig_bytes); vk.verify(&payload, &sig).is_ok() }
